title: VeriRL: Boosting the LLM-based Verilog Code Generation via Reinforcement Learning
problem: LLM-based Verilog generation struggles with concurrency semantics, syntactic rigidity, and sparse/noisy simulation feedback, limiting hardware code quality.
method: Reinforcement learning framework with Trace-back based Rescore mechanism for reward reliability, sample-balanced weighting for catastrophic forgetting mitigation, and co-evolution of policy and reward models.
key_novelty: First RL-driven approach for Verilog generation with iterative policy-reward co-evolution and trace-based feedback.
contributions: Veribench-53K high-quality Verilog dataset with 700K+ problems
Trace-back based Rescore mechanism for reward robustness
State-of-the-art pass rate and functional correctness improvements
